rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for how strongly one material sticks to another.

example.english: The adhesion of this double-sided tape is very strong, so it sticks wood and metal firmly.
example.traditional: 呢款雙面膠紙黐力好強，木板同金屬都黐得實。
example.jyutping: ne1 fun2 soeng1 min2 gaau1 zi2 ci1 lik6 hou2 koeng4 muk6 baan2 tung4 gam1 suk6 dou1 ci1 dak1 sat6

rows.note: Use this for a person's continuing loyalty or attachment to someone, a group, or a cause.

example.english: His adhesion to this team has never wavered.
example.traditional: 佢對呢個團隊一直都好忠心。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi2 ni1 go3 tyun4 deoi2 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 zung1 sam1

rows.note: Use this as the ordinary noun for agreeing to a proposal or arrangement.

example.english: This arrangement needs everyone's adhesion before it can be put into practice.
example.traditional: 呢個安排要有大家同意先可以落實。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 on1 paai4 jiu3 jau5 daai6 gaa1 tung4 ji3 sin1 ho2 ji5 lok6 sat6
